segments: For lo, thine enemies make a tumult.
And they that hate thee have lifted up
their head.
>> All the nations hate the nation of
Israel. All the nations  hate our
rise. They do not want us to come out of
being the dead fruit. They don't want us
to be that lively fruit.
They don't want us to be that.
So, they'll do everything in their power
to try to destroy our young men,
to destroy our young women, to destroy
our families, our wives, our daughters,
our sons.
All times are evil.
Even even the things that the nations
want, they would program
our own people
and get them to act as agents of an
enemy to try to destroy us.
>> Read that again.
>> For lo, thine enemies make a tumult. And
they that hate thee have lifted
up their head.
>> So, this opposition is so great because
not only is it going to come from our
natural enemies, some of our people are
going to join with  the enemies
to try to destroy us.
